item.title: GIT-FLOW Cheatsheet
item.author: emecas
item.description:
GIT-FLOW Cheatsheet
Efficient branching using git-flow by Vincent Driessen
Daniel Kummer’s one-page guide to git-flow, the git extensions for Vincent Driessen’s branching model (2010): a develop branch next to master, and short-lived feature, release and hotfix branches, each started and finished with one command. Translated into about thirty languages.
http://danielkummer.github.io/git-flow-cheatsheet/ ★ star note
https://github.com/danielkummer/git-flow-cheatsheet ★ star note

git-flow are a set of git extensions to provide high-level repository operations for Vincent Driessen’s branching model.
